comparison_initial_state_rule: Equivalent circular radius from published mean baseline fluorescein area31.4mm2; no fitted geometry. Ratio of cohort means, not mean of individual baseline ratios.
method: At each actually measured hour, merge overlapping area intervals of all black pixels in3-column band. Each remaining separated cluster implies >=1 observation. Sum lower bounds / entire study20animals. Unseen/overlapping curves contribute zero. No per-arm size, IDs, mean estimate or CI inferred.
interpretation: One-sided falsification only: reject if any minimum possible absolute error exceeds0.10 OR lower RMSE bound exceeds0.05 over all5times. Otherwise indeterminate; no passing biological validation from these weak constraints.
limitations: Original curve data, exact animal IDs/per-arm counts not recovered.
Pixel allowance is fixed engineering digitization allowance, not a statistical confidence interval.
Source nominal6mm and measured fluorescence31.4mm2 differ; use declared observed baseline, never select geometry after candidate.
Fluorescein and curvature-corrected OCT are distinct measurements; do not combine.
Source is independent of Abdel-Naby2017 but was inspected before new fit; no blinded-study claim.
